## Goal

The WebSocket client: connect with the token, subscribe to one board, parse
events, reconnect with backoff and re-subscribe.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `frontend/src/api/socket.ts`
- `frontend/src/api/socket.test.ts`
- `frontend/src/test/fakeWebSocket.ts` (a fake reused by later tickets)

### Steps

1. `export type SocketStatus = "open" | "closed"`; `export interface BoardSocket { subscribe(boardId: number | null): void; close(): void }`; `export function connectSocket(opts: { token: string; onEvent(ev: ServerEvent): void; onStatus?(s: SocketStatus): void }): BoardSocket`.
2. URL: `${location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:"}//${location.host}/api/ws?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`.
3. On `open`: report `"open"`, reset the backoff, send the remembered subscription (if any). On `message`: `JSON.parse` in try/catch; pass on `{type: "board"}` with an object `board` and `{type: "boards.changed"}`; ignore everything else. On `close` (not after `close()`): report `"closed"` and reconnect after the next delay of `[1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 10000]`, staying at 10000.
4. `subscribe(id)`: remember it; when the socket is open send `{"type":"subscribe","board_id":id}` (for `null`, just forget). `close()`: mark closed, clear a pending reconnect timer, close the socket, never reconnect.
5. `fakeWebSocket.ts`: `export class FakeWebSocket` with static `instances`, `url`, `sent: string[]`, `readyState`, `send`, `close`, and test helpers `open()`, `receive(data: unknown | string)`, `serverClose()`; `export function installFakeWebSocket()` stubbing the global and resetting `instances`.
6. Run `make verify` and make it pass.

### Tests to add

- `socket.test.ts` (fake timers): URL with an encoded token (`a b&c`); `wss:` under an https location (stub `location`); board and boards.changed events delivered; bad JSON, unknown type and a `board` event without an object are ignored; subscribe before open is sent on open, subscribe while open is sent at once, `null` forgets; status reports; reconnect delays 1, 2, 4, 8, 10, 10 s; backoff resets after an open; the subscription is re-sent after reconnect; `close()` stops reconnects even with a timer pending.
